__broaden__.ἀπηύρων: ἀπαυράω — take away, deprive of; impf. 3 pl., epic (augmented ἀπ-ηύρων), + acc. of the thing taken: ’they took away’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I took away’
__broaden__.ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σι (= Attic ἐθέλῃ), after αἴ κ’: ’if he wishes’ · also in a general relative clause after ἥν κ’: ’whichever he wishes’
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’)
__broaden__.ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
__broaden__.ἱρὴν: ἱερός (epic ἱρός) — holy, sacred; fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρήν (= Attic ἱεράν) · also Ἱρή — Hire, a town; fem. acc. sg. (proper name)
__broaden__.ὀνομήνω: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. subj. 1 sg. (fut. has the same form), potential with ἂν: ’I could name’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg. as a statement of intent: ’I will name’
__broaden__.ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of its verb: ’whatever’ (ὅσσά κεν αὐτοὶ δῶσιν ’whatever they themselves may give’) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with its noun: ’as many (prizes) as’ (ὅσσά … ἀέθλια)
